statement: GroupMember.toManifestJson excludes local-only fields while toJson includes them and round-trips.
GroupMember.name prefers the local name, then display name, then a truncated uid.
Avatar resolution: plain suppresses, local override wins, otherwise the received path; clearAvatarPhotoPath resets the override.
Group round-trips through toJson including groupKey and charter; toManifestJson excludes local-only fields.
A legacy emoji key is read into avatarEmoji and migrated on the next write.
Member role defaults to member and is omitted from a role-less manifest; a non-default role is published and round-trips.
Unknown or legacy role names deserialize to member and never throw.
Group role helpers resolve the owner via ownerUid and a co-owner via role.
A pure-member group manifest is byte-identical to the pre-roles golden output.
Group.fromJson captures unknown keys into extra and toManifestJson re-emits them.
An extra entry can never shadow or fabricate a recognized key.
GroupMember.extra is local-only: it survives toJson and never appears in toManifestJson.
copyWith(extra:) replaces the bag so omitting a key clears it.
publishCounter is omitted from the wire at zero, published when bumped, and round-trips.
createGroup mints a hash-bound charter that validates for the new groupId.
addMember is idempotent for a self-consistent member.
addMember throws when the uid does not match the box key.
addMember throws on a malformed or wrong-length public key.
removeMember drops the member and rotates the group key.
removeMember rotates the key even when the uid was not a member.
encryptManifestFor/decryptManifest round-trip between owner and member.
decryptManifest rejects a manifest naming a different group than the pinned expectedGroupId.
decryptManifest drops an unbound roster entry rather than rejecting the manifest.
decryptManifest rejects a usurped manifest not from the charter owner.
decryptManifest rejects a replayed older charter below minCharterHeight.
decryptManifest rejects a manifest whose publishCounter is below minPublishCounter.
Under the tolerant policy a diverged charter is accepted that strict rejects.
The tolerant policy relaxes only charter authority; the groupId pin and other checks stay strict.
Under tolerant a usurped manifest is accepted (documented tradeoff).
An adopter wire field in Group.extra survives the manifest round-trip.
decryptManifest returns null and never throws on tampered, truncated or garbage blobs.
transferOwnershipWithCharter appends a valid link naming the new owner.
Transfers are retry-idempotent when the target already owns the group.
The charter builder refuses to mint a link the validator would reject.
Transfer refuses to silently downgrade when the new owner's Ed25519 key is unknown.
transferOwnership throws for a non-member.
A two-transfer chain validates to height 3.
encryptWithGroupKey/decryptWithGroupKey round-trip arbitrary data.
setRole promotes a member to co-owner without rotating the key.
sealKeyForMember/unsealKey round-trip only for the named member.
unsealKey returns null and never throws on hostile sealed content.
The golden-vector charter validates to the expected owner and height 1, and its genesis groupId matches.
An empty chain is rejected with empty_chain.
A chain over kMaxCharterEntries is rejected with chain_too_long before any crypto.
A non-map entry or an entry missing payload/sig or carrying extra keys is rejected.
A link in first position or a genesis in a later position is rejected.
Float versions or timestamps, out-of-JS-safe-range or negative timestamps, and wrong version numbers are rejected.
Missing or extra payload fields and non-string, null or non-ASCII fields are rejected.
Undecodable base64 in a key field is rejected.
A chain for another groupId is rejected so links cannot be grafted.
An ownerUid not derived from its own box key is rejected.
A forged genesis signature is rejected.
A genesis whose groupId is not the hash of its payload is rejected.
idBinding legacy is rejected with genesis_not_hash_bound and an unknown binding is rejected.
A well-formed transfer link chain validates.
A link not signed by the outgoing owner is rejected.
A link with a spliced prevHash is rejected.
A self-link is rejected so height cannot be inflated.
A non-increasing link timestamp is rejected.
A link grafted from another group's chain is rejected.
charterEnforcedOwner returns the tip owner key and height for a valid chain.
charterEnforcedOwner fails open (null) with no charter, an invalid chain or a diverged tip.
charterEnforcedOwner refuses a chain shorter than minHeight.
charterEntryGroupId returns null on malformed entries and never throws.
decryptManifest rejects a wrong-length groupKey and a charter tip key differing from the sending owner's key.
bumpedForPublish increments publishCounter by one.
